description: Create a role from a vetted preset (none, member, moderator, admin) and/or an explicit list of permission names. Administrator is never granted by a preset; it must be spelled out explicitly. Supports dry_run.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

permissions.description: Extra permission names, like manage_messages or ban_members.
